name: Species
definition: A biological classification for living organisms, including plants, animals, and fungi.

name: Geographical Location
definition: A specific area or place, including countries, cities, mountains, rivers, and villages.

name: Educational Institution
definition: An organization that provides instruction or education, including schools, colleges, and universities.

name: Banking and Financial Institution
definition: An organization that provides financial services, including banks and investment firms.

name: Cultural Work
definition: A creative work such as a book, film, album, or artwork.

name: Historical Figure
definition: A person of historical significance, often involved in politics, arts, or social movements.

name: Government and Political Entity
definition: An organization or body that governs or administers a political unit, including governments and political parties.

name: Infrastructure
definition: Physical structures and facilities, including bridges, roads, and buildings.

name: Medical Institution
definition: An organization that provides medical services, including hospitals and clinics.

name: Sports Entity
definition: An organization or individual involved in sports, including teams, athletes, and sports clubs.

name: Media Organization
definition: An organization that produces or disseminates news and information, including newspapers and television stations.

name: Religious Institution
definition: An organization that practices and promotes religious beliefs, including churches and temples.

name: Company or Business
definition: An organization engaged in commercial, industrial, or professional activities.

name: Artistic Work
definition: A creation in the field of art, including paintings, sculptures, and performances.

name: Natural Feature
definition: A naturally occurring physical feature of the Earth, such as mountains, rivers, and lakes.
